fields.description: Queue Picking/Delivery/Putaway work automatically from Pick List, Delivery Note and Purchase Receipt events, and let staff claim the next task.
fields.label: Enable WMS Auto Queue

fields.description: Raise an Idle alert when an employee has been IDLE this long.
fields.label: Idle Alert After (minutes)

fields.description: Raise an Overdue alert when an active work session is past its target time by this long.
fields.label: Overdue Alert After (minutes)

fields.description: Raise a Blocked alert when a work session has stayed BLOCKED this long.
fields.label: Blocked Alert After (minutes)

fields.description: Remind the employee themselves (PWA notification, and push if set up) when they have been IDLE this long. 0 = off.
fields.label: Remind Employee After Idle (minutes)

fields.description: Track an employee (Work Now popup, idle reminders, alerts) only after they Punch In. Off = tracking follows the Work Shift alone.
fields.label: Require Punch In for Tracking

fields.description: The employee must allow location on the phone to Punch In or Out.
fields.label: Punch Needs Location

fields.description: Compare each punch with the office point below and mark it Inside / Outside.
fields.label: Check Location Against Office

fields.description: Refuse Punch In when the employee is outside the allowed area (otherwise it is only marked Outside).
fields.label: Block Punch Outside Area

fields.description: These users receive every supervisor alert (realtime toast + notification bell).
fields.label: Alert Recipients

fields.description: Delete Employee Work Log rows older than this many days (0 = keep forever).
fields.label: Activity Log Retention (days)

fields.description: Delete cleared Employee Watcher Alert rows older than this many days (0 = keep forever).
fields.label: Cleared Alert Retention (days)
